10 秒快速接入代码

from openai import OpenAI

# 1. 初始化客户端（使用 Hyperbolic AI 专属 API 接口地址）
client = OpenAI(
    api_key="YOUR_API_KEY",  # 填入申请到的 Hyperbolic AI API Key
    base_url="https://api.hyperbolic.xyz/v1"
)

# 2. 发起对话请求（使用官方免费支持的模型）
response = client.chat.completions.create(
    model="meta-llama/Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct",
    messages=[
        {"role": "user", "content": "你好！请用一句话介绍你自己。"}
    ]
)

print(response.choices[0].message.content)
curl https://api.hyperbolic.xyz/v1/chat/completions   -H "Content-Type: application/json"   -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY"   -d '{
    "model": "meta-llama/Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct",
    "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "你好！"}]
  }'
import OpenAI from "openai";

// 1. 初始化客户端
const openai = new OpenAI({
  apiKey: "YOUR_API_KEY",
  baseURL: "https://api.hyperbolic.xyz/v1",
});

// 2. 发起请求
const response = await openai.chat.completions.create({
  model: "meta-llama/Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct",
  messages: [{ role: "user", content: "你好！" }],
});

console.log(response.choices[0].message.content);
